confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain because July falls in the Queensland school holidays, when prices run high and vary widely by property. FX observation taken from search-result summaries attributed to rba.gov.au; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Australian coastal tourism centres with similar pricing, such as the Sunshine Coast and Cairns, adjusted for Gold Coast's high-rise and beachfront accommodation market. Restaurant and drink prices follow general Australian urban levels.
